effect.name: Transform + Motion Blur
effect.description: Position, scale, rotation and opacity with physically-based motion blur. Set Shutter Angle to 0 to disable the blur (acts as an on/off switch) while keeping the transform.
effect.author: mlt-shutterblur (filter by RocketJannis, MLT PR #1301)

parameter.name: pivot_x
Rotation Pivot X
parameter.comment: 0 = left edge of the rectangle, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge. Only affects rotation.

parameter.name: pivot_y
Rotation Pivot Y
parameter.comment: 0 = top edge of the rectangle, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge. Only affects rotation.

parameter.name: shutter_angle
Shutter Angle
parameter.comment: 0 = motion blur off. 180 = standard film/video look. 360 = maximum blur (full frame-to-frame motion).

parameter.name: samples
Blur Quality
parameter.comment: Number of samples used to build the blur. Higher = smoother but slower to render.
